reserveReview.rationale: KK Yap & Associates SSAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable-assurance examination as of 31 August 2026 11:59 PM Singapore time, signed 28 September 2026: USD46,324,677 cash, zero fixed deposits and zero government/repo instruments against USD46,182,310 XUSD in circulation. The four disclosed chain supplies reconcile exactly; composition remains 100% cash. The safeguarding institution and provider shares remain undisclosed.
